title: Full-Stack Developer (Node / TS) | Scale-up | 60–80 K€
description:
We are working with a German sustainability software scale-up with over 550 employees and 2,500 clients worldwide, ranging from SMEs to large corporations. Its multi-tenant platform helps companies comply with ESG regulations, manage their supply chains and improve transparency and efficiency. We are looking for full-stack developers for the Business Partner Transparency team, which provides companies with insights into their suppliers to help them comply with regulations.

📍 Madrid · Hybrid (3 days a week in the office) · €60,000–80,000 gross per year, depending on experience

What will you do?
Design, build and optimise full-stack features using modern technologies: Node.js and TypeScript on the back-end and React on the front-end, with a focus on scalability and maintainability.
To develop software solutions that automate complex compliance workflows for businesses of all sizes.
Work with the product, design and engineering teams in small agile teams (4–6 people) to define, refine and implement features.
Ensure secure, high-quality code through rigorous reviews, automated testing and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).
To be responsible for the architecture and design of solutions in TypeScript, optimising performance, reliability and user experience.
Contribute to technical strategy and decision-making by identifying opportunities for innovation and process improvement.
Support junior developers and foster a culture of learning and technical excellence.

What we’re looking for
Essential
4+ years’ experience in full-stack development using Node.js, TypeScript and React.
Experience in start-ups, SaaS companies or product-based companies.
Practical experience with AI-assisted development and agent-based engineering environments.
Experience in web services and integration (REST, etc.) and with Git.
Product mindset: thinking beyond the code, about the user, the business impact and scalability.
Agile experience: sprints, stand-ups and rapid iteration.
English C1 or equivalent (the team is international).

What they offer
A mission with a purpose: to tackle complex sustainability challenges alongside global industry pioneers, in a fast-growing company.
A space for creativity, with a focus on teamwork and a culture of open communication.
Flexibility and team spirit with a hybrid model.
Sustainable transport options and events with global teams.
industries: Technology, Information and Internet, Software Development, and IT System Custom Software Development
